text:
anya: heads-up — packaging for onprem v1.4.3 is ready for transport tests. chunking changed to 256MB to reduce mirror time. please review.

owen: ack. what's the new manifest layout? any signer change?

anya: manifest adds chunk_index + total_chunks; cosign sig unchanged. KMS unchanged. example manifest line: `{"name":"onprem-installer","chunk_index":3,"total_chunks":12}`

deploy-bot: Deploy started: onprem-installer v1.4.3 -> private-vpc staging. canary size=2

matt: FYI staging mirror reported 502 on chunk 7 during initial upload, retrying.

leah: logs? paste the deploy-bot error

matt: deploy-bot: upload failed to s3-mirror-3 | 502 Bad Gateway | retry 1/3

anya: ok hold cutover. let's not promote until mirror completes and cosign verifies checksum.

sophia: rollback plan? if a mirror corrupts, we need to pin previous installer tag and abort promote. recommend tag r1.4.2-rollback-ready

owen: +1. propose gating rules: (1) all chunks uploaded and verified, (2) cosign verified, (3) SHA256 of assembled tarball matches packaging hash, (4) smoke canary passes in 3 nodes

leah: add that deploy-bot should auto-unpin on failure and open a rollback ticket.

deploy-bot: Canary failures: node-2 smoke test failed (timeout). Pausing promotion and triggering rollback checklist.

anya: I'm rolling back upload attempt, re-assembling and running `sha256sum ./onprem-installer.tar.gz`. will re-generate shrinkwrap if mismatch.

matt: re-upload in progress. ETA ~18m.

sophia: make sure release notes mention chunking change and the new manifest fields. ops need clear verifier steps.

anya: noted. adding release_notes.md entry and sending to legal for export control check. will ping when ready.

owen: if we need emergency rollback after partial promotion, do we have a hotfix cut branch ready? who owns? @anya

anya: I own hotfix branch. can cut r1.4.3-hotfix and pin images to previous shard ids.

leah: documented rollback steps here:
```
1. deploy-bot abort promote
2. pin installer tag to r1.4.2
3. invalidate CDN caches for manifest
4. notify customers via status page
```

matt: mirror finished, cosign OK, assembled tar SHA256 matches. moving to canary staging again.

deploy-bot: Promotion resumed: canary -> 2 nodes. monitor latency and install success for 10 minutes.

sophia: good. after 10m, if passes we'll schedule full rollout in next 30m window. ops — stand by.

leah: :thumbsup: 

anya: thanks all. will push final release notes + changelog and close thread.
